_about: Academy-rule spellings the script can't derive from the niqqud (how the name is said differs from its pointing, or a borrowed name). Each entry: the spelling and why. Read by scripts/names-content/build-latin.mjs.

מרדכי.reason: The hataf kamats under ד is said e (Mordekhai).

יששכר.reason: The second ש is not said.

קטרין.reason: Borrowed name said with a, not a kamats katan.

קתרין.reason: Borrowed name said with a, not a kamats katan.

טשארנא.reason: טש is one sound here; no vowel between them.

אושן.reason: Borrowed (Ocean): the last syllable is said with e.
